activity.notes: Christopher Columbus led four transatlantic voyages for the Castilian Crown between 1492 and 1504. The submitted West Indies label is a geographic and colonial label, not an independent sovereign state that he ruled. This records the well-documented expedition career; disputed formal governorship termination dates are not converted into a falsely precise continuous office here.
